name: semtext
//specVersion: Draft revision of spec/conventions.{html,md} that the demo pages and landing copy self-label. Bump it WITH the spec, not with releases — `version` is the package, `specVersion` is the format draft.
description: SemText — XHTML-first semantic markup: one document that reads as a styled interactive page, a structural record for LLMs, and plain text in a terminal. One Lit bundle (dist/semtext.js + its stylesheet + themes); degrades to plain prose with JavaScript off. Zero React.
//exports: Two full bundles, two lazy loaders. `./lit` is the core bundle — a classic IIFE that installs the global `SemText` (the sem-* custom elements, the vanilla handlers, extraction as SemText.extractRecords/SemText.extractText) and exports NOTHING — consume it as a <script src> tag / CDN asset, or as a side-effect ESM import (`import 'semtext/lit'`, which registers the custom elements and runs the handlers). Named imports are not available from it. `./npl` is the npl-* namespace as its own IIFE (global `NPL`) — optional, loaded on top of the core only by NPL documents; core carries no npl code. `./lazy` and `./npl-lazy` are the on-demand surfaces — ES modules for pages served over http(s) that import only the component chunks the document's sem-* / npl-* tags use (dist/chunks/ and dist/npl-chunks/, generated manifests; never from file:// — saved single files use `./lit` / `./npl`). `./themes/*` is raw CSS; the built vocabulary ships as dist/semtext.css inside `files`. The former ./fallback, ./reading, ./extract and ./md subpaths are retired with their artifacts — everything they installed is a name on the one global. There is deliberately no '.' export: ROADMAP debt D9 was 'type: module' advertising an ESM package whose root mapped to a non-importable script. Dropping '.' removes the false promise rather than papering over it.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-standalone.mjs && node scripts/build-extension.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs
scripts.build:strict: node scripts/build.mjs --strict-budget && node scripts/build-standalone.mjs && node scripts/build-extension.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs
scripts.//validate: web/demo is excluded: demo pages are frozen historical examples, excluded from vocabulary gating 2026-10-18 (web/ currently holds only demo/ + site/, so site/ + spec/ stay fully gated)

happy-dom.//: Only bin/semtext-validate + src/validate import happy-dom at runtime; the semtext/lit bundle and dist/semtext.js never do. Library consumers can skip it; CLI users get an actionable error without it.

xslt-processor.//: Only bin/semtext-agent's xslt command imports it at runtime, and only when the xsltproc binary is absent; every other command runs without it.
